newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $280 mln for Tuesday, March 25.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $280 mln for Tuesday, March 25.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, March 25 are expected to total $280 million in 26 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $106 million in 6 sales, with a $44 million Delaware State Housing deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 20 sales totaling $175 million are on the schedule, a $39 million Connecticut Health and Educational deal at 1100 EST is the largest.
An additional 11 sales totaling $528 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
